title: A file's own citations rank first: context() serves the decisions, lessons and references the queried file names by id, above every other tier
acceptance_criteria: a file that names a store id gets that object in its bundle whatever its scope and whatever the task, marked cited, ranked above path-bound items; a directory or unreadable path behaves exactly as before; the usage record counts cited items

title: A compaction ends a session's context cover: an edit after the context window was compacted needs a context() call made after it
acceptance_criteria: the SessionStart hook records a compaction boundary for the session; a context() call before the boundary no longer covers an edit after it; a call after it does; branch-window and agent-session fallbacks obey the same boundary; nugit stats is unchanged for sessions that never compacted
